reuse.why: Introduces a shared getBulkBudgetCategories selection used by setZero, the N-month averages and the new setLastMonthSpending, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own getBudgetData path and re-checks hidden/template/fixed inline.

duplication.why: The #fixed group check and the income/tracking check are repeated verbatim in five actions instead of living in the selection, and copyPreviousMonth re-implements the whole exclusion rule a second time.

placement.why: Selection logic sits in actions.ts next to the actions, which fits the tree, but the exclusion rule is split between SQL (hidden, goal_def) and per-action JS (fixed group) and between two query helpers.

scope.why: Changes stay in budget actions, the handler registration and tests; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: A future exclusion must be added in the helper SQL, in every action loop and in copyPreviousMonth; copyPreviousMonth also ignores includeHiddenCategories and reads goal_def that getBudgetData never selects.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth does not use getBulkBudgetCategories and applies hidden/goal_def/#fixed checks on getBudgetData rows itself; every action applies isFixedGroup outside the shared selection.

disguised_duplication.where: The exclusion rule is split: hidden/template in getBulkBudgetCategories SQL vs. re-expressed as JS conditions on getBudgetData rows in copyPreviousMonth (prevBudget.hidden/group_hidden/goal_def/isFixedGroup).

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories gains includeHiddenCategories with a conditional SQL fragment; copyPreviousMonth bypasses it; the #fixed rule stays at each call site rather than in the helper.
